problem: The vector $a$ has magnitude $9,$ the vector $b$ has magnitude $5,$ the angle between $a$ and $b$ is ${140}^{∘}$ and $n$ is the unit vector that points in the direction of $a\times b.$ Find $a\times b$ in terms of $n.$ Round your final answer to the nearest integer where appropriate.

feedback.problem:
Given the vector $u$ has magnitude $4$, the vector $v$ has magnitude $9,$ the angle between $u$ and $v$ is ${75}^{∘}$ and $n$ is the unit vector that points in the direction of $u\times v.$ Find $u\times v$ in terms of $n.$ 

Type $n$ to represent the vector $n$ and round your final answer to **one decimal place** where appropriate.

$u\times v≈$
{{field-1}}
feedback.worked_solution:
We use the formula for the cross product and obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}u\times v & =|u|\cdot |v|\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡\theta \cdot n \\  & =4\cdot 9\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡{75}^{∘}\cdot n \\  & =36\cdot (0.965\,92…)\cdot n \\  & =(34.773\,32…)\cdot n \\  & ≈34.8n.\end{aligned}
$$
